landing.title: Business finance, clearly managed
landing.heroTitle: Run your finances from one calm, accurate workspace.
landing.heroBody: Ledger Suit turns daily money activity into a reliable double-entry ledger, live cash visibility, commitments, automation, and decision-ready reports.
landing.trialNote: 14 days free · Payment method required · Cancel before renewal
landing.featuresTitle: From a receipt to the full financial picture
landing.featuresBody: Every workflow shares the same secure organization ledger, so figures remain traceable and consistent.

cashflow.title: Cash visibility
cashflow.body: See balances, inflows, outflows, and upcoming obligations in one view.

ledger.title: Controlled accounting
ledger.body: Atomic double-entry posting keeps every journal balanced and auditable.

commitments.title: Commitments
commitments.body: Track receivables, payables, due dates, partial settlements, and overdue items.

automation.title: Recurring automation
automation.body: Schedule repeat activity while keeping review and posting controls.

reports.title: Decision-ready reports
reports.body: Use profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, and cash-flow views.

team.title: Secure collaboration
team.body: Invite a team with precise roles and strict organization isolation.
